lines.text: Barnaby the bullfrog sat on his giant lily pad, rubbing his plump green tummy!
He had already eaten twenty crunchy flies, but his eyes were bigger than his stomach!
A golden swarm buzzed overhead, and Barnaby snapped: I want every single one!
SLURP! He stuffed thirty more flies into his mouth until his cheeks bulged!
Groan! His tummy was so swollen and heavy, his lily pad began to sink under water!
He couldn't leap, he couldn't sing, and he had a giant bellyache all afternoon!
Little Dragonfly fluttered by: Enough is a feast, Barnaby. Greed only sinks your pad!
Knowing when to stop and enjoying what you have brings genuine peace!
